prepared_not_independently_ranked.evidence: A models.tsv and prepared workflow exist, but no local canonical score/summary bundle was located; all15 settings are contained in completed45-model cavity-mass-q grid. Do not count as15 additional completed independent fits.

latest_continuum.chi2_caveat: Not the fitting metric or a formal goodness-of-fit statistic; no calibrated covariance or likelihood. Included for descriptive use only.

physical_model.mass_caveat: Nominal input dust masses; cavity carving removes envelope cells, so report separately from the final integrated material remaining. Actual post-carving mass not established by this audit.
physical_model.q_definition: dn/da proportional to a^(-q); not the spatial density exponent
physical_model.envelope_grain_type: Mie, silicate core + ice mantle, mixing rule2 coating
physical_model.cavity_mapping: For exponent1, half opening=atan(r0/h0); finite spherical polar grid empties discrete cell rows. Current17.5 degree state empties3 polar-centre rows.

methodology.measurement: Signed full-Mueller spatial Method2 total-I plane0, post-PSF, fractional1arcsec-radius aperture centered at CRPIX; coeval Method2 SED closure is a numerical check.
methodology.not_the_scored_estimator: Legacy SEDtotal times image aperture fraction; separated component reconstructions are quality diagnostics, not canonical scored flux.
methodology.score: S = sqrt[(1/6) sum_over_regions (sum_over_anchors w_j log10(Fobs/Fmodel)^2 / n_region_primary)]. No fitted amplitude; equal outer region weighting, geometric observed flux at overlapping detector bins.

w000.role: User-excluded first point; diagnostic-only in reanalysis of36-model grid and completely absent from final45-model generation/scoring.

methodology.uncertainty: 0.0108579276dex is operational numerical score-resolution tolerance, not Gaussian error, parameter error bar, confidence interval, or posterior.

limitations: Historic totals use different apertures/normalizations/masks/distances; do not plot all scores as an improvement curve or combine in a likelihood.
Latest mass2.25 and q2.75 hit lower grid boundaries; continuum minimum not bracketed.
Cavity17.5vs20 degree preference unresolved and changes with boundary weighting; polar grid also makes opening discrete.
Strong model mismatch remains outside nine strict anchors; ice and silicate bands were excluded from this continuum fit.
The H2O dust changes reuse continuum temperature; their later best dust is not a thermally self-consistent global continuum refit.
Spatial exponent remained−1.5; notes calling q a density exponent are wrong.
No formal likelihood, posterior samples, or parameter confidence intervals were generated.
Current stellar mass, disk structure, source luminosity, inclination and extinction are largely fixed assumptions; their literature consistency must be reconsidered jointly.
